Irish Statute Book private (provisional-order confirmation) acts 1923-2005 nos. 1-5 were scanned: county-line changes are only Waterford 1955 (Kilkenny), Wicklow 1957 (Dublin), Drogheda 1977 (Meath to Louth); city extensions otherwise stay inside their own county.

events.what: Waterford county borough extended into Counties Kilkenny and Waterford

sources.title: Local Government Provisional Orders Confirmation Act, 1955 (County Borough of Waterford (Extension of Boundary) Provisional Order, 1955)
sources.says: In force 1 April 1955: areas of County Kilkenny and County Waterford added to the City of Waterford.

events.what: Part of County Dublin (Bray area) transferred to County Wicklow

sources.title: Wicklow County (Extension of Boundary) Provisional Order, 1957, confirmed 1957
sources.says: In force 1 April 1957: an area detached from the County of Dublin and added to the County of Wicklow (Bray area).

events.what: Cork county borough extended into County Cork

sources.title: S.I. No. 141/1965 – County Borough of Cork (Extension of Boundary) Provisional Order, 1965 (commencement)
sources.says: The County Borough of Cork (Extension of Boundary) Provisional Order, 1965 comes into force on 1 July 1965.

events.what: Part of Drogheda transferred from County Meath to County Louth

sources.title: Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation Act, 1976 (County of Louth and Borough of Drogheda (Boundaries) Provisional Order, 1976)
sources.says: In operation 1 Jan 1977: an area detached from County Meath and added to County Louth and to the Borough of Drogheda.

events.what: Waterford county borough extended into County Waterford

sources.title: Local Government Provisional Order Confirmation Act, 1979 (County Borough of Waterford (Extension of Boundary) Provisional Order, 1979)
sources.says: Order comes into operation 1 Jan 1980; area of County Waterford added to the county borough of Waterford.

events.what: Dublin county borough/County Dublin boundary altered (both directions)

sources.title: S.I. No. 129/1985 – Local Government (Reorganisation) Act, 1985 (Commencement) (No. 2) Order
sources.says: Sections 10 and 18 (Dublin city/county boundary transfers) come into operation on 9 May 1985.

sources.title: Local Government (Reorganisation) Act, 1985
sources.says: s. 5: Borough of Galway ceases to be part of the county on the appointed day as County Borough; s. 10: Dublin city/county boundary altered.

events.what: Galway becomes a county borough, leaving County Galway

sources.title: S.I. No. 425/1985 – County Borough of Galway (Appointed Day) Order, 1985
sources.says: 1 January 1986 is the appointed day on which Galway becomes a county borough.

events.what: County Dublin replaced by Dún Laoghaire–Rathdown, Fingal and South Dublin; city boundary altered

sources.title: Local Government (Dublin) Act, 1993
sources.says: On the establishment day the city/county boundary is altered (s. 8) and Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown, Fingal and South Dublin counties are established (s. 9).
